description:
These beachfront apartments for sale in Manilva on the Costa del Sol are set in one of the most authentic and peaceful stretches of the Mediterranean coast. Positioned just steps from the beach, the homes combine contemporary architecture, generous outdoor spaces and open sea views, allowing residents to enjoy the natural rhythm of life by the sea.

The development will feature a collection of homes with one, two, three and four bedroom layouts. Each residence includes spacious open plan interiors that open onto large terraces, bringing the Mediterranean landscape into everyday living. Generous outdoor areas provide space for dining, relaxing and enjoying the sea views and mild climate throughout the year.

High construction standards and carefully selected finishes ensure comfort, elegance and long-term value. Owners also have the opportunity to personalise certain design elements and finishes, allowing each home to reflect individual preferences while maintaining a contemporary architectural style.

Residents will enjoy a range of amenities designed to support both relaxation and social living. Landscaped gardens surround communal swimming pools, while wellness facilities include an indoor pool, spa and fully equipped gym. Additional spaces such as coworking areas and communal lounges create flexible environments for both work and leisure, while underground parking and storage rooms provide everyday practicality.

The location adds another important dimension to these apartments. Set along the Manilva coastline, the development sits just moments from wide sandy beaches and the relaxed atmosphere of this stretch of the Mediterranean. The nearby marina offers restaurants, cafés and nautical activities, while Estepona, Sotogrande and Marbella are all within easy driving distance.

A distinctive aspect of the area is its rich history. Archaeological remains from the Roman period have been discovered nearby and will be preserved as part of the project through an interpretive museum on site, offering residents and visitors a direct connection to the region’s past.

This part of the Costa del Sol is known for its natural beauty, relaxed atmosphere and excellent connections to both Malaga and Gibraltar airports. Golf courses, marinas, hiking routes and coastal towns are all close by, making the area particularly attractive for both permanent living and holiday homes.

With beachfront surroundings, modern design and an authentic Mediterranean setting, these Costa del Sol apartments present an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of the most distinctive coastal lifestyles in southern Spain.
